title: lotus macranthus
intro: Lotus macranthus, commonly known as the Himalayan lotus or Indian lotus, is a species of aquatic plant that belongs to the Nelumbo genus. It is prized for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its high antioxidant content. The plant is also valued for its therapeutic actions, such as aiding in the treatment of diabetes and certain types of cancer, as well as exhibiting antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Lotus macranthus include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
